description: List and filter the 42 compiled Go and Tree-sitter AST Definition of Done quality gates, 7 Canonical Laws, and sandbox rules. Example: gate_id='G-16' or law=7 returns matching gate invariants. Use when browsing gate invariants by G-* ID, Law 1..7, or category. Do NOT use when troubleshooting a raw verify error log or ERR_* failure (use diagnose_nomos_error instead).

gate_id.description: Optional gate identifier such as G-01 or G-16.

law.description: Optional Canonical Law number from 1 through 7.

name: inspect_dod_gates

canonicalUrl.description: Canonical documentation or twin URL for citation.

matchedCount.description: Number of gates matching the filter.

totalGates.description: Total compiled quality gates in Nomos.

title: Inspect 42 Compiled DoD Gates & Laws
